name: Kitwe
registryBasis: Zambia’s government NSDI service `NSDI_Vector/CadasterNew/MapServer/0` identifies its `Lots` parcel layer as “Lots from ZILMIS”. The layer has Polygon geometry, EPSG:32735 source coordinates, public query capability and safe native `SDE.Lots.UPID` (“Plot ID”). Kitwe City Council separately lists planning/land-use services. A bounded 100 m query around the WUP point found four transport IDs and a safe-field fetch retained three full polygons with only UPID. No owner/address/account attributes or transport OIDs were retained.
scopeLimits: 31 valid distinct public cadastral-reference polygons verified in thirteen bounded 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged WUP settlement locator. Complete bounded manifest paging, forced three-row pages, all 31 fresh source-ID reads, explicit absence, footprint and source binding passed in 54 requests. Independent metric EPSG:32735 GEOS found all geometries valid and distinct, with no sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. Source-native SDE.Lots.OBJECTID is the unique GIS reference identity; the original UPID label is retained unchanged. The first UPID identity qualification is preserved as failed: one blank UPID matched 38,736 records and cannot serve as a unique native parcel key. A fresh run using source OIDs preserves all sampled geometry and passes every query check. Provider offset pagination is unsupported; complete count-checked object-ID manifests and bounded object-ID batches are used instead. Native source CRS is EPSG:32735. The exact WUP point returned no lot; all three original nearby UPID-labelled samples match fresh full source geometry exactly. Citywide completeness, legal title, survey accuracy, currentness and long-term GIS key continuity remain unverified.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
remainingUncertainty: Citywide completeness, legal title, currentness, survey accuracy and long-term native GIS identity continuity remain unverified.
nextStep: No runtime qualification was attempted. If more discovery is needed, inspect additional first-party metadata and use only bounded geometry requests with a safe native GIS key.

queries.query: Kitwe Zambia official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS City Council
queries.scope: Find city-local registry/map evidence and inspect whether anonymous parcel geometry can be safely requested.
queries.result: Official Zambia NSDI REST metadata identifies the `Lots` polygon layer and describes its source as ZILMIS. Its schema includes native UPID plot IDs, survey reference/area/date and land-use fields; no owner/address/account field is needed. Exact WUP point returned no parcel IDs; a 100 m native-coordinate buffer returned four transport IDs, and a fetch of three of them returned three complete Polygons with only UPID requested.
queries.executionMethod: Separate language search; official government portal/service review; no property-specific lookup.
